schema_path_notes: SchemaRecommender still writes new drafts to outputs/unified-schema.json; the CLI default reviewed input is checked in separately. Explicit schema paths and per-run copies remain supported.
path_rule: All paths are relative to the project root unless explicitly absolute.

format_rules.json: UTF-8, valid JSON, two-space indentation when written to disk
format_rules.yaml: UTF-8, valid YAML, two-space indentation, no tabs, and quoted date-like strings when they must remain strings
format_rules.csv: UTF-8 with a header row; source column names are preserved exactly
format_rules.field_order: Source-field outputs preserve source column order

diagnostics_contract.fatal_behavior: Do not write or overwrite the primary output. Raise an exception and make the CLI exit non-zero.
diagnostics_contract.warning_behavior: Write the primary output and record warnings in the diagnostics sidecar.

llm_dependency.purpose: Infer business meaning from field names, samples, and profile statistics.
llm_dependency.plain_code_responsibility: Validate inputs, enforce structured output, preserve field order, and check required fields.

inputs.name: csv_file
inputs.notes: The full CSV is profiled locally; it is not sent directly to the LLM.

llm_dependency.purpose: None for MVP; policy decisions are deterministic Python.
llm_dependency.plain_code_responsibility: Combine analyses, calculate source coverage, apply modeling policy, and validate the schema.

inputs.name: field_analyses
inputs.format: JSON object keyed by CSV filename

llm_dependency.purpose: Draft semantic source-to-target mappings and explain non-obvious transformations.
llm_dependency.plain_code_responsibility: Check field existence, duplicate mappings, types, required targets, confidence thresholds, and transformation syntax.

llm_dependency.purpose: None; execute sample transformations with ordinary Python.
llm_dependency.plain_code_responsibility: Check rule configuration and examples, transform sampled rows, validate target values, and report outcomes.

runtime_missing_policy.missing_amount_conversion: Return null, subject to target nullability; never substitute zero

exit_codes.0: No failed rules; warnings and manual review may remain
exit_codes.1: Failed rules or fatal input errors

llm_dependency.purpose: None; create draft configuration from mappings, schema and validation evidence.
llm_dependency.plain_code_responsibility: Verify current input fingerprints, preserve validated steps, disable failed or review-required rules, and keep loading disabled.

inputs.name: customer_mappings
inputs.format: Two YAML files: customer and order

inputs.name: primary_validation_results
inputs.format: Two JSON files matching the configured input CSVs

inputs.name: additional_validation_results
inputs.format: Optional JSON reports for additional test datasets using the same mappings/schema
inputs.notes: Failures in these reports also prevent a rule being marked executable.

ETLConfigGenerator.warning_passthrough: MappingValidator warnings retain their code and add validation_report.

llm_dependency.purpose: None for MVP; descriptions, rationales, and lineage already exist in structured inputs.
llm_dependency.plain_code_responsibility: Validate and join schema, analyses and mapping drafts; render consistent JSON and Markdown without approving or executing transformations.

inputs.name: field_analyses
inputs.format: JSON object keyed by CSV filename, or one FieldAnalyzer result

inputs.name: mapping_drafts
inputs.notes: All supplied version 1 mappings are documented, including explicit review rules. Rules follow the MappingGenerator contract. Source fields must exist in the matching analysis, identified by source CSV basename and table_type.

consistency_rules: One entry per schema field, preserving schema table and field order, exact type, nullable and business description.
Mappings own source lineage, expressions and example values; analyses supply source descriptions, confidence and evidence.
Explicitly unmapped nullable fields remain visible with no invented examples. Missing customer mappings and coverage disagreements produce warnings.
Manual-review rules and low-confidence interpretations remain flagged. Mapping examples are documented, not validation evidence.
No CSV rows, validation reports, API calls or database access are required. Input SHA-256 values support regeneration checks.

llm_dependency.required: Live FieldAnalyzer and MappingGenerator only; explicit artifact reuse bypasses their API calls.
llm_dependency.plain_code_responsibility: Ordered orchestration, input selection, schema reuse, persistence, validation, draft export and run logging.

inputs.schema_generation: --recommend-schema explicitly opts into a single-run draft; function schema_path=None has the same meaning.
inputs.csv_selection: Exact <source_slug>_customers.csv and <source_slug>_orders.csv in input_dir, or both explicit CSV paths.
inputs.output_safety: Directory must be new or empty; run_log.json is exclusively created; completed prior runs are not overwritten.

run_log.diagnostics: Controller consolidates shared-shaped error/warning items per step and at top level in run_log.json; standalone module CLIs retain their sidecar contracts. Top-level errors add step and fatal.

OnboardingAgent.failure_policy: Exceptions fail the current step, mark downstream steps skipped, preserve completed artifacts and exit 1. Validation row/rule failures remain nonfatal findings and become disabled review steps in ETL drafts. Completed review drafts exit 0 with warnings.
OnboardingAgent.reuse_policy: Schema bytes are preserved. Analyses require matching filenames, field order and table types but semantic freshness is not proven. Reused mappings must match the exact source CSV paths and are structurally checked; sample validation is rerun.
OnboardingAgent.limits: One source system and exactly one customer/order CSV pair per invocation. No database loading or autonomous tool selection.

change_control.rule: Any contract change must update contract_version and be recorded in docs/module-contract-change-log.md.
change_control.compatibility: Additive optional fields are minor changes; renamed or removed required fields are breaking changes.
